investigation.limitations: Development-only document-family coverage. Not held-out answer quality, diagnosis correctness, or calibrated answerability. Synthetic cases authored during the flagship redevelopment after source inspection; labels reflect the six-document corpus scope.

retrieval.limitations: Agent-authored synthetic questions; no external users or independent human labels. Held-out cases were specified before the first metric run and are now public regression cases. Document-level relevance only; no human answer-quality scoring. Lexical negatives are not a safety or answerability benchmark. Stress queries are descriptive and not release thresholds.

limitations: Synthetic, agent-authored scenarios and coarse reference checks. No independent human answer-quality scoring. Matching source quotes do not prove entailment. Independent GGUF conversions confound causal SFT interpretation. No external-user impact established.
